description: Plan a timed edit from a description: picks and orders clips across different shoots and locations, sets a cut length for each at the chosen pace, and totals the license cost. Returns an edit decision list with preview URLs for a storyboard or rough cut. It does not render video or license anything.

category.description: Optional scene category or curated slug, as in search_footage.

pace.description: Editing pace: slow (4 to 8s per clip), balanced (3 to 6s), fast (2 to 4s). Default balanced.

people.description: Use 'none' for a people-free cut. Default any.

query.description: Description of the sequence, for example 'baja road trip along the coast' or 'whales and dolphins in the Sea of Cortez'.

target_seconds.description: Target timeline length in seconds, 20 to 600 (default 60).

name: build_rough_cut
title: Build Rough Cut Timeline
